who_results.title: Tubular adenoma
who_results.excerpt: Entity: Tubular adenoma definition: Tubular adenoma is a benign apocrine neoplasm comprising lobules of multiple irregularly shaped tubular structures that have a double-to several-layered cell lining (inner epithelial and outer myoepithelial), embedded in a fibrous stroma. related_terminology: Acceptable: Tubular papillary adenoma; papillary eccrine adenoma; tubular apocrine adenoma essential_and_desirable_diagnostic_criteria: Essential: Lobules consisting of multiple irregularly shaped tubular structures that have a double- to several-layered epithelial lining, embedded in a fibrous stroma.

who_results.title: Tubular adenoma
who_results.excerpt: Entity: Tubular adenoma definition: Tubular adenoma is a benign dermal neoplasm composed of tubules and glandular structures with or without papillae. related_terminology: Acceptable: tubular papillary adenoma; tubular apocrine adenoma. Not recommended: papillary eccrine adenoma; tubular syringoadenoma. essential_and_desirable_diagnostic_criteria: Essential: lobules of irregularly shaped tubules with a dual or multilayered epithelium embedded in fibrous stroma. Desirable: intraluminal micropapillae lacking a fibrovascular core.
